description: Studie Winterstrom aus Photovoltaik - Produktionsprofile aller Schweizer Gemeinden is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Energie BFE. Exportdaten der Studie "Studie Winterstrom Schweiz - Was kann die heimische Photovoltaik beitragen?" (2019). In dieser Studie wird in drei Szenarien überprüft, wie gross der Anteil der Photovoltaik (PV) an der Winterstromversorgung der Schweiz sein könnte. In dieser Winterstromstudie werden für alle Gemeinden der Schweiz Produktionsprofile für PV-Anlagen für die Jahre 2004 – 2018 generiert. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Bundesamt für Energie BFE. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-03-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
